scheme_name: Stipend Scheme For Poultry Farming Training For Divyang People
other_conditions: Beneficiary must be an adult Divyang (disabled) person residing in Gujarat.
Beneficiary must provide an income proof certificate.
Female applicants and Below Poverty Line beneficiaries will be given priority.
benefits_summary: Maximum ₹2000 stipend for six days of training (₹300 per day plus ₹200 transport) and a poultry training certificate upon completion.
